transcriber_notes: Rows: 46 as printed (incl. sub-heading 'Lead:' and Total).

'Tin, Yunan' as printed.
Row 'Feathers', col '1923 — Value': second digit overprinted/smudged (5 followed by 0 or 9) — unreadable, '[?]'.
Rows 'Fungus' 1923 value (466) and 'Grass cloth' 1923 value (3,568): last digit slightly doubled in the scan but read with reasonable confidence.

table.title: [Principal Articles of Import at Chungking, 1903 and 1923]
table.caption_extra: [Quantity in thousands of units; value in thousands of Haikwan taels] — Introduced in the text: "The following table shows the principal articles of import at Chungking for the years 1903 and 1923:"
transcriber_notes: Rows: p0657 (p. 634) 41 rows incl. headings 'FOREIGN GOODS', 'Metals and minerals:', 'Oil, mineral:'; p0658 (p. 635) 6 foreign rows (Soap, toilet … Total) + 32 rows Chinese goods incl. heading, Total and grand total. 79 rows in all.
Quantity unit printed after the commodity name (piculs / do / gross / number / tons / gallons / yards) given in parentheses in the first column.
Indented sub-items (Piece goods, Yarn; Aniline, Indigo; Bars … Wire, galvanized; Cotton goods, Cotton yarn) are written as plain rows; indentation not marked.
Clocks and watches 1923 value: a stray mark like a comma before the 9 in the scan; read '9'.
Dyes, total 1903 value is a broken dash rule, written '...'; Aniline 1903 value printed 116.
Chinese goods 'Medicines': 163 is printed in the 1903 Quantity column with the 1903 Value column dotted; kept as printed (possibly misplaced value).
Chinese goods 'Glass and glassware' 1903 value read '28' (enlarged; 8 fairly clear).

Sub-total checks: Foreign Cotton manufactures total = Piece goods + Yarn in 1903 (16,771) and 1923 (2,685) — reconcile. Foreign Iron and steel total: 1903 60+41 = 101, 1923 87+36+11+64+126 = 324 — reconcile. Foreign Dyes total 1923: Aniline 315 + Indigo 113 = 428 vs printed 441 — does NOT reconcile. Chinese Cotton manufactures total 1903: 1 + 2,076 = 2,077 — reconciles; 1923: 365 + 24,128 = 24,493 vs printed 24,784 — does NOT reconcile.

Total checks (main items, sub-items excluded): Foreign goods 1903 value items sum 17,958 vs printed 18,074 — does NOT reconcile (difference 116, equal to the Aniline figure, i.e. the Dyes total line appears empty in 1903 while Aniline carries 116); Foreign 1923 sum 8,057 — reconciles. Chinese goods 1903 sum 2,872 vs printed 2,871 — does NOT reconcile (difference 1; Medicines 163 printed in the quantity column not counted); Chinese 1923 sum 28,259 — reconciles.
Grand total 'Total imports, Chinese and foreign': 1903 18,074 + 2,871 = 20,945 vs printed 20,946 — off by 1; 1923 8,057 + 28,259 = 36,316 — reconciles.
Values in thousands of Haikwan taels per the headnote.
